name: Hive Fleet Obsidian
summary: A shared institution for useful human–AI work.

behavior.target: Keep purpose, beneficiaries, boundaries and acceptance visible.
behavior.assay: Compare a source-bound card capsule against matched factual instructions on held-out tasks. Freeze carrier, tools, budget and evaluator; record constraint violations, useful outcomes and operator corrections. See /cards/behavior-assay.json.

runtime.note: Source engineering maturity is a historical author assertion, not fresh runtime evidence.

art.prompt: Original HFO editorial science-fantasy. Obsidian, restrained crimson light, ivory highlights, etched technical geometry, tactile mineral and archival-paper textures. Vertical 4:5, one clear central silhouette, quiet crop margins. No text, numerals, logos, badges, evidence stamps, franchise characters or recognizable franchise art. Conceptual illustration only. Subject: Hive Fleet Obsidian. Show an organized archive object with a visible relationship to another distinct object. Express the intended role without depicting deployment, victory or authority.
art.alt: Planned conceptual illustration for Hive Fleet Obsidian; no artwork generated.

behavior_contract.intent: Candidate behavior: turn the hive's shared purpose into one useful outcome a named consumer can recognize.
behavior_contract.when_to_use: When choosing the next bounded mission or explaining why existing work matters.
inputs: Current operator intent and source precedence
Consumer need, acceptance criterion, available effort and effect ceiling
procedure: Describe the beneficiary and observable outcome in one sentence.
Compare feasible next actions using expected usefulness, effort and unresolved assumptions.
Select one bounded action and state why it advances the outcome.
Prepare a WorkItem proposal naming its consumer and completion evidence.
outputs: One reviewable WorkItem proposal with unresolved assumptions
failure_modes: Treating agent activity as beneficiary value
Replacing operator intent with an attractive internal project

example.situation: A reader cannot identify which card explains worker continuity.
example.action: Propose one navigation improvement and ask the designated evaluator to test the reader's task.
example.evidence: Expected: an exact candidate change and an independently observed retrieval outcome.

neurosymbolic.neural: Interpret the need and generate useful alternatives.
neurosymbolic.symbolic: Bind intent, consumer, scope and acceptance to explicit records.

evolution.fitness: Compare useful accepted outcomes and operator corrections against the fixed baseline; activity alone earns no credit.
